verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a payments API platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The only related claim is a generic line about confirming payment outcomes and triggering post-purchase actions in real time, which does not describe a webhook mechanism a programmatic consumer can subscribe to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
